gamemoderun.label: GameMode
gamemoderun.about: Puts your CPU (and on some setups the GPU) into performance mode while the game is running.

game-performance.label: Performance power profile
game-performance.about: Switches the system power profile to performance while the game runs, then back afterwards.

mangohud.label: MangoHud overlay
mangohud.about: Shows FPS, frame times and temperatures on top of the game.

prime-run.label: Use the NVIDIA GPU
prime-run.about: On laptops with two GPUs, runs the game on the faster NVIDIA card.

PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI.label: NVIDIA features (DLSS, Reflex)
PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI.about: Lets the game talk to your NVIDIA driver, so DLSS and Reflex can be turned on in the game's settings.

DXVK_ENABLE_NVAPI.label: NVIDIA features for DXVK
DXVK_ENABLE_NVAPI.about: Older way of exposing NVIDIA features to DirectX 11 games.

PROTON_ENABLE_NGX_UPDATER.label: Keep DLSS up to date
PROTON_ENABLE_NGX_UPDATER.about: Lets the NVIDIA driver update the game's DLSS files to newer versions.

PROTON_HIDE_NVIDIA_GPU.label: Hide the NVIDIA GPU
PROTON_HIDE_NVIDIA_GPU.about: Makes the game think you have an AMD card. Fixes a few games that break on NVIDIA, but turns off DLSS.

PROTON_FORCE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE.label: More memory for 32-bit games
PROTON_FORCE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE.about: Lets older 32-bit games use more than 2 GB of RAM, which fixes out-of-memory crashes.

PROTON_SET_GAME_DRIVE.label: Game folder as a drive
PROTON_SET_GAME_DRIVE.about: Gives the game folder a Windows drive letter. Some launchers and mod tools need this.

PROTON_PREFER_SDL.label: SDL controller input
PROTON_PREFER_SDL.about: Uses SDL for controllers, which fixes double input or controllers not being detected in some games.

PROTON_USE_XALIA.label: Controller UI helper
PROTON_USE_XALIA.about: Turns Proton's controller navigation helper on or off. Reports show what works for this game.

PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC.label: Audio buffer
PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC.about: Raises the audio buffer, which fixes crackling or stuttering sound.

PROTON_HEAP_DELAY_FREE.label: Delayed memory release
PROTON_HEAP_DELAY_FREE.about: Works around crashes in a few games with memory bugs. Can raise memory use.

PROTON_USE_WINED3D.label: OpenGL renderer (WineD3D)
PROTON_USE_WINED3D.about: Uses the older OpenGL path instead of Vulkan. Fixes some crashes and black screens, but usually lowers FPS a lot.

PROTON_USE_WINED3D11.label: OpenGL renderer for DirectX 11
PROTON_USE_WINED3D11.about: Same as the WineD3D option, only for DirectX 11. Usually lowers FPS.

PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND.label: Native Wayland window
PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND.about: Runs the game as a native Wayland window. Can feel smoother, but some games crash, lose input or open on the wrong screen.

PROTON_NO_ESYNC.label: Turn off esync
PROTON_NO_ESYNC.about: Disables a speed-up that a few games don't like. Usually costs some FPS.

PROTON_NO_FSYNC.label: Turn off fsync
PROTON_NO_FSYNC.about: Disables a speed-up that a few games don't like. Usually costs some FPS.

PROTON_NO_NTSYNC.label: Turn off ntsync
PROTON_NO_NTSYNC.about: Disables the kernel sync speed-up. Only helps a handful of games.

PROTON_NO_D3D11.label: Hide DirectX 11
PROTON_NO_D3D11.about: Forces the game onto an older DirectX version. Fixes a few games, lowers FPS in most.

PROTON_NO_D3D10.label: Hide DirectX 10
PROTON_NO_D3D10.about: Forces the game onto an older DirectX version.

PROTON_VKD3D_HEAP.label: VKD3D heap option
PROTON_VKD3D_HEAP.about: Experimental DirectX 12 memory option. Can fix crashes or cause new ones.

VKD3D_CONFIG.label: VKD3D experimental options
VKD3D_CONFIG.about: Turns on experimental DirectX 12 features. Results vary from game to game.

VKD3D_FEATURE_LEVEL.label: DirectX 12 feature level
VKD3D_FEATURE_LEVEL.about: Changes which DirectX 12 features the game sees.

WINEDLLOVERRIDES.label: DLL overrides
WINEDLLOVERRIDES.about: Changes which Windows DLLs the game loads. Needed for some mods, can stop the game from starting.

PROTON_ENABLE_HDR.label: HDR output
PROTON_ENABLE_HDR.about: Turns on HDR. Needs an HDR screen and compositor support.

DXVK_HDR.label: HDR for DXVK
DXVK_HDR.about: Turns on HDR for DirectX games. Needs an HDR screen and compositor support.

SDL_VIDEODRIVER.label: SDL video driver
SDL_VIDEODRIVER.about: Changes how the game opens its window.

RADV_PERFTEST.label: AMD driver test features
RADV_PERFTEST.about: Turns on experimental features in the AMD Vulkan driver.

__GL_SHADER_DISK_CACHE_SKIP_CLEANUP.label: Keep NVIDIA shader cache
__GL_SHADER_DISK_CACHE_SKIP_CLEANUP.about: Stops the NVIDIA driver from throwing away compiled shaders, so games stutter less after the first run.

__GL_SHADER_DISK_CACHE_SIZE.label: Bigger NVIDIA shader cache
__GL_SHADER_DISK_CACHE_SIZE.about: Gives the NVIDIA driver more room for compiled shaders, which cuts stutter in big games.

MESA_SHADER_CACHE_MAX_SIZE.label: Bigger shader cache
MESA_SHADER_CACHE_MAX_SIZE.about: Gives the graphics driver more room for compiled shaders, which cuts stutter in big games.

-dx11.label: Start in DirectX 11
-dx11.about: Starts the game with DirectX 11, which often runs better under Proton.

-vulkan.label: Start in Vulkan
-vulkan.about: Uses the game's own Vulkan renderer, which usually runs best on Linux.

-force-vulkan.label: Start in Vulkan
-force-vulkan.about: Uses the game's own Vulkan renderer.

-skip-launcher.label: Skip the launcher
-skip-launcher.about: Goes straight into the game instead of the publisher's launcher, which often breaks under Proton.

--skip-launcher.label: Skip the launcher
--skip-launcher.about: Goes straight into the game instead of the publisher's launcher.

--launcher-skip.label: Skip the launcher
--launcher-skip.about: Goes straight into the game instead of the publisher's launcher.

-nolauncher.label: Skip the launcher
-nolauncher.about: Goes straight into the game instead of the launcher.

-nojoy.label: Turn off joystick support
-nojoy.about: Stops the game from looking for controllers. Fixes some stutter, but controllers won't work.
